p.em: (Be sure that you can carefully put into words the meanings of each of these statement in terms of ice cream and money.)

static.solution:
(a) The statement f(275) = 225 means that it costs 225 dollars to produce 275 gallons of ice cream.
(b) The statement f'(275) = 1.8 means that when the number of gallons produced is 275, costs are increasing by 1.8 dollars/gallon In other words, it costs about 1.8 dollars to produce the 276th gallon of ice cream.
